description: A focused marketplace for independent music releases, film, physical media and creator editions. Rights, checkout and delivery status stay visible.

surface.eyebrow: Music · Film · Physical media · Creator editions
surface.headline: Sound, stories, and things worth keeping.
surface.tagline: A focused home for independent releases and collectible media. Preview what you can, see exactly what is included, and buy only when rights, checkout, and delivery are ready. No ghost listings. No mystery files.
surface.community_heading: A clean release, from rights to delivery

community_blocks.title: Rights before listing
community_blocks.body: Publish only when ownership, distribution permission, credits, and allowed uses are documented.

community_blocks.title: Exact deliverables
community_blocks.body: Buyers see the format, edition, runtime or track list, delivery method, and refund terms before checkout.

community_blocks.title: Patreon + Discord, by approval
community_blocks.body: Community access and creator perks are reusable capabilities, triggered only by verified entitlements and idempotent settlement evidence.

categories.title: Music releases
categories.description: Albums, singles, mixes, live sessions, and physical editions with artist credits, track lists, formats, and preview links where available.

categories.title: Screen & moving image
categories.description: Independent film, visualizers, short-form work, and behind-the-scenes editions with runtime, captions, and playback details.

categories.title: Physical media & art
categories.description: Posters, zines, printed editions, and media collectibles with condition, edition details, shipping, and return terms.

categories.title: Creator editions
categories.description: Licensed stems, sample packs, artwork bundles, and project files with explicit usage rights and exact deliverables.

categories.title: Collectible media
categories.description: Physical editions can be resold when the seller has the item and can accurately describe its condition and fulfilment.

categories.title: Creative services
categories.description: Bounded services with scope, deliverables, revision limits, timeline, and acceptance criteria stated before checkout.

surface.empty_state: No verified releases are published yet. Inventory stays empty until supply and rights are verified.
surface.footer_copy: Music & Media · independent releases, rights, and delivery evidence.

clone_steps: clone the MTG master shell without creating a new HTML template
replace only the silo slug and supply this manifest
copy data/_catalog-empty.template.json to the isolated catalogue
compile registry and fee policy from the same manifest
run CUBE clone verifier and Gauntlet
publish only after explicit approval and verified supply

accept_if: generated shell matches MTG master except slug
rights, checkout, settlement, fulfilment and delivery gates are fail-closed
